scope: Independent deterministic audit of PGS005228 counted alleles against the project's harmonized FI GWAS; no editing or reconstruction of score file
sampling: Before looking at matching results, sample records if first two bytes of SHA256(rsID | chromosome | position) interpreted big-endian are < 64, approximately 1/1024
matching: Only unique rsID matches with exact GRCh37 chromosome and coordinate; compare PGS counted allele to either of the source GWAS's distinct alleles; retain absent, duplicates, mismatches, and missing source coordinates
limitations: Harmonized FI input excludes MHC, palindromic variants, and other variants. Sample represents its matched subset only; PGS and GWAS share source; no effect-weight, PGS predictive validity, or sample-independence conclusion.
